remarks: Step into this bright and welcoming renovated first floor unit, offering 3-4 bedrooms and 2 full baths. Enjoy an open concept floor plan filled with natural light, complemented by beautifully finished hardwood flooring. The modern kitchen features stainless steel appliances, flowing seamlessly into the living and dining areas perfect for everyday living & entertaining. The finished lower level includes 3 versatile rooms & full bath, providing an excellent option for a 4th bedroom, guest suite, home office, or recreation space. Additional highlights include: Private in-unit laundry, ample storage throughout, front and back porches, level yard and off street parking for one car. Ideally located close to the beach, pool, parks, schools, restaurants, and public transportation. A must see property, don't miss this opportunity!
